Unlimited Korean Fried Chicken (KFC) with a drink included for only £20. @cheemclondon in Soho is a place to go all out with your mates. This deal is available Monday to Thursday only. Do not pull up on weekends expecting to get this🤦🏾‍♂️

They have 11 flavours on offer which I think is excellent. You get 6 wings in every portion & you can also choose boneless pieces too. I tried every flavour & probably bar two, I liked every one. Especially the Honey Butter, a powdery substance but it’s like it melt into the batter of the wing. It was crazy!

The Order:

🍗 Unlimited Wings & Drink £20
🍗 Flavours On Offer: Naked, Honey Butter, Korean BBQ, Sweet Chilli, Red Devil, Sweet Soy, Korean Buffalo, Hawaiian Volcano, Mad Garlic, Creamion, Oriental Green

Overall = 4.5/5

🤔After seeing people queuing in the rain for this, we went to see what all the hype was about at @pastationlondon.  What we found:
✅Fresh Pasta
✅Ingredients imported from Italy 
✅A dozen different pastas to choose from
✅Made Fresh right in front of your eyes
✅A restaurant full of Italians
✅Affordable
.
😋So yes, it is worth the hype.  It is absolutely fabulous pasta here.  The lobster special was probably the best seafood pasta dish we have ever had!  The creaminess and seafood flavours were just a joy.  Everything is imported from Italy (even the eggs) so it’s basically like you’re in Rome.
.
*PR Invite
.
📍 Goodge Street Station (literally on the doorstep of the station)
💷 Pasta starting from £5.95

Get ready for a taste explosion @thewhaleteauk 

Asian bakeries are pure magic, in my opinion at least! They’ve perfected the art of creating mouthwatering treats that leave you wanting more! 😍

From bread to delicious pastries, they’ve got it all! 
The softness of their bread and that brioche bun taste, ugh literally chef’s kiss.

It’s a level of deliciousness you won’t find in your average bakery goodies! 🙌

Not only do these treats taste incredible, they’re visually stunning too! 

Prepare for a feast for your eyes as you enter this bakery paradise. Each item is a work of art, beautifully crafted to perfection. Don’t miss out! 

Give this Chinese bakery a go, and I promise you’ll be blown away! 🤩 It’s a solid 10/10 on the flavor scale, and you’ll be counting down the minutes until your next visit!

A must visit in Soho 😮‍💨

AD- INVITE | @thirteen_ldn has been on my radar for a month now and I needed to check it out, especially as the food is created by @cuepointldn 🤤 This is a stunning bar that’s opened a few months ago in Tottenham Court Road and it’s definitely a secret as it doesn’t seem very popular..yet 👀

The food here is so good. We had the No.2 sharing plate which had two of the following: brisket slider, smoked chicken Naan tacos, pumpkin naan tacos, aubergine naan tacos, Zaatar potatoes. This was £39 between two people. Honestly the chicken tacos are my favourite and I will definitely go anywhere where @cuepointldn makes the food 😂 The drinks are stunning too as we had the Soho (£16) and the Lady Stardust (£16). Really recommend checking this out!

Location: Tottenham Court Road
Price: ££-£££
Requirements: vegetarian options available, mocktails available, Halal food but double check

reel.caption:
Tiramisu French Toast of dreams @thegrandportobello 😍

This has been on my list for a while and I'm glad I finally tried it! It was really good 👌

The toast itself is so thick and fluffy and it's topped with Mascarpone Cream and Cocoa Powder. The cream does get a little sweet towards the end but it's too good not to finish 😅 

I personally think it would have been nice to have a bit of espresso on the side to dunk it in ☕️

reel.caption:
🌟HANKKI🌟
🚨 There’s a new Korean spot in central @london 🤩

If you’re looking for a fun and casual meal, which is also something a bit different, @hankki.london could be just what you need! Serving up mouthwatering fusion dishes to creative cocktails, here, you can experience a new wave of Korean food. 

We had an absolute feast but our favourite dishes had to be:
▪️Crispy Quail
▪️Spicy Pork Tacos
▪️Grilled Stone Beef Brisket 
▪️Black Pink (deep fried chicken with Ptaya sauce) 
▪️Chicken wings in four sauces

They also make their own Soju 😍 it was so fun trying them all but if we had to pick one, we’d go for the Hankki Melody which had hints of Aloe Vera in it 🤤 it went down perfectly with the Hankki Beer 🍻 

Add it to the list and let us know what you think!
